items.title: System design kya hai aur interview mein kya test hota hai
Client, server aur API: kaun maangta hai, kaun deta hai
Website kholte hi andar kya hota hai
DNS: naam se machine ka address kaise milta hai
HTTP aur HTTPS: padlock asal mein kya karta hai
TCP vs UDP: reliable ya fast, kab kaun
REST vs gRPC: ek server doosre server ko kaise bulaye
Latency vs throughput: ek request kitni der, aur ek second mein kitni
Back-of-envelope: users se requests per second tak ka hisaab
